title: Duplicate package names not supported (colcon) and "already built in one or more underlay workspaces": copies, ignore files and --allow-overriding, measured
excerpt: Why colcon stops with exit 1 when two folders share a package name, which ignore files hide a copy (COLCON_IGNORE, AMENT_IGNORE, CATKIN_IGNORE, not lowercase), when --paths helps, and why the underlay warning and --allow-overriding need colcon-override-check. Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical.
